_common: image[1] is a 1996 game render of a weapon. Redraw this exact weapon as one clean, detailed, high-resolution product render for a 3D model: the same three-quarter view and the same proportions, silhouette and parts, the whole weapon visible, neutral studio lighting, plain white background, no shadow, no hands, no text. Modernise the detail (panel lines, screws, materials) in a gritty 1990s cyberpunk style while keeping its key features and colours. Weapon:

uzi.desc: a compact futuristic Uzi-style submachine gun, boxy black gunmetal receiver with bright steel edges, short barrel with a round muzzle, straight magazine inside the pistol grip, a small square sight block on top, small cyan indicator lights on the side; one-handed sidearm size.

minigun.desc: a heavy cyberpunk minigun: a rotating cluster of six chrome barrels at the front, a thick purple-and-black armoured cylindrical body with a polished chrome band, a curved white ceramic pistol grip underneath, a black carry handle with grip ridges on top, rounded rear housing.

laser.desc: a long cyberpunk laser rifle: thick polished chrome cylindrical barrel ending in a rounded muzzle, segmented ribbed chrome body with a curved top rail, a short angled pistol grip under the rear, small cyan emitter details.

ellaser.desc: the electron mace: a heavy chrome gun with three short stacked round barrels at the front, a boxy ribbed receiver with cooling vents and panel cut-outs, an angled pistol grip at the rear.

rap.desc: a slim shoulder rocket launcher: long polished silver tube with dark purple bands and a sighting block, the rear end is a dark purple hooked housing that curves down into a ring-shaped grip.

persuadrtrn.desc: the persuadertron: a compact chunky chrome handheld device, wide round emitter nose with a lens, boxy top housing, a square loop-shaped grip and base underneath.

flamer.desc: a flamethrower: boxy black armoured body with purple trim stripes and a small light strip on top, a white ceramic nozzle tip at the front, a vertical cylindrical fuel canister under the body used as a fore grip.

h2htaser.desc: a hand-held taser baton: wedge-shaped glossy purple casing that widens toward the back, two short metal prongs at the narrow front end, a silver oval button on the side, black grip edges.

longrange.desc: a very long thin sniper rifle: needle-thin long barrel, compact black receiver with purple accents, a small scope on top, a skeletal folding shoulder stock.

beam.desc: the graviton beam gun: a chrome tube barrel, dark purple central body with a top carry grip, an angled chrome rear elbow housing with a round end cap.

sonicblast.desc: a sonic blast cannon: long polished chrome barrel with a wide flared muzzle, segmented chrome body with a curved top fin, a short angled pistol grip under the rear.

qdevastator.desc: the devastator: a long heavy rifle with an octagonal (bevelled box) cross-section in dark chrome, a thick bevelled muzzle block with a small round bore and a downward front grip under it, a stepped wider receiver in the middle with a curved pistol grip below, and a raised rear housing ending in a bevelled point. Two cylindrical silver energy cartridges plug into the rear housing, one on each side, sticking out diagonally upward and outward at 45 degrees; two round ports on the rear side. NO scope, NO sight, NO dials or knobs on top.

persuader2.desc: the persuadertron mk2: a larger bulky chrome handheld device with a round lens emitter nose, layered housing on top, a square loop grip and base underneath.

stasisfld.desc: a stasis field projector: open-frame chrome device, cylindrical emitter at the front with cyan lights, a purple lower rail with cyan lights, a ring-shaped frame at the rear as the grip.

soulgun.desc: a heavy soul gun: dark chrome body with a large round spherical pod in the middle, forked prongs at the front, a chunky rear grip and stock.

timegun.desc: a time gun: open-frame device, a purple-and-silver rectangular rear block with a glowing slot, thin chrome rails, a ring at the front, small cyan lights.

nuclgren.desc: a nuclear grenade: a long dark chrome cylindrical canister with a rounded front cap, a ringed collar and short angled fins at the rear, a small hazard light.

crazygas.desc: a gas grenade canister: a stubby polished chrome cylinder with a ribbed screw cap on one end and a flat vented nozzle on the other, segmented bands around the body.

kogas.desc: a knock-out gas grenade: a stubby brushed silver cylinder with a ribbed screw cap on one end, a vented nozzle on the other and an engraved triangular warning mark on the side.

elemine.desc: an electric mine: a flat chunky device made of two angular chrome housings joined by a purple core block, small blocky contacts on top, sits flat on the ground.

explmine.desc: an explosive land mine: a flat bevelled dark grey armoured box with chunky corner blocks and a raised lid panel, sits flat on the ground.

napalmmine.desc: a napalm mine (NOT the box of image[1], only its style): a flat round armoured disc with a raised centre trigger and two small orange fuel canisters on its sides, dark grey metal with orange hazard stripes, sits flat on the ground.

airstrike.desc: an airstrike designator: two long slim dark chrome tubes lying side by side, each with a rounded end cap and a small sensor head at the other end.

razorwire.desc: a coil of razor wire: a loose loop of steel wire studded with sharp purple-tinted blades, lying in two overlapping rings.

energyshld.note: the shop art for the energy shield shows another weapon; the game reuses the clone shield model

cerebusiff.desc: the Cerberus IFF unit: a small four-legged metal frame, a central square hub with four angled jointed legs ending in clawed feet, like a stand or drone base.

medi1.desc: a medikit: a rectangular silver metal case with bevelled edges, purple corner bands and a recessed purple cross on the lid.

medi2.desc: an advanced medikit: a rectangular silver metal case with bevelled edges, purple bands, a star-shaped emblem with a cross on the lid and a small display.

explwire.desc: explosive wire: a thin glowing cyan cable lying in two loose loops, with small metal connector ends.

cloneshld.desc: a clone shield device: a flat rectangular chrome card-shaped unit with a recessed grey panel and a purple striped emitter edge on one side.

ashpile.ref: game sprite dead_ash (agent, last frame), see work/props/ashpile/ref.png
ashpile.desc: (NOT a weapon: image[1] is the last frame of a burnt-to-ash death in the game, a small black char mark seen from above) the remains of a person burnt to ash: a low, flat, roughly person-length patch of black and dark grey ash lying on the ground, a loose mound in the middle with charred fragments and a few splayed streaks spreading out like limbs, a few tiny glowing orange embers, flakes of grey ash; no recognisable body, no bones, no flames, seen from three-quarter above.

_common_scenery: image[1] is a tiny 1996 game sprite of a piece of city scenery, seen from about 30 degrees above. Redraw this exact object as one clean, detailed, high-resolution product render for a 3D model: the same shape, proportions and colours, the whole object visible, standing upright, three-quarter view from slightly above, neutral studio lighting, plain white background, no shadow, no ground, no text, NOT pixel art. Realistic gritty 1990s cyberpunk city style. Object:

tree_conifer.desc: a tall dark green conifer tree, narrow cone shape, dense needles, short brown trunk

tree_blossom.desc: a round ornamental tree covered in pink blossom, dark trunk

tree_willow.desc: a weeping willow tree with long hanging yellow-green branches down to the ground

tree_round.desc: a small tree with a dense rounded dark green crown on a short trunk

bush.desc: a low wide rounded green hedge bush

tree_planter.desc: a small round dark green tree growing in a round dark red stone planter

tree_dead.desc: a dead bare black tree with twisted drooping branches, no leaves

tree_dead_planter.desc: a dead black spiky bare tree in a round dark red stone planter

tree_red.desc: a small tree with dark red autumn foliage

lamp_large.desc: a large street lamp: a thick dark metal post with a red band near the base and a wide round white lamp head on top

lamp_post.desc: a tall thin black metal street lamp post with a small round lamp at the top and a small yellow light near the base

lamp_post_red.desc: a tall thin black metal street lamp post with red bands along the pole and a small round lamp on top

lamp_post_globe.desc: a tall street lamp with a grey metal pole and a dark globe lamp on top, wider base

neon_pole.desc: a tall glowing cyan neon light tube on a short dark purple metal base

bin_grey.desc: a tall grey metal street litter bin with a domed lid

bin_white.desc: a white-grey metal street bin with a rounded lid and a dark band

barrel_yellow.desc: a yellow metal industrial barrel with dark bands

barrel_blue.desc: a blue-purple metal industrial barrel with dark bands

barrel_burning.desc: a rusty red metal barrel with fire burning out of its open top

planter_hazard.desc: a short round grey metal street planter or bollard with yellow and black hazard markings on its rim

fountain_base.desc: a low round dark blue-grey stone fountain basin

bowl_chrome.desc: a large polished chrome bowl-shaped street urn or fountain on a short base
